title: Tabata and Prince Takehara / Kinue Takehara and Ryouko Ueda
overview: Musicians fly into Awajima chasing a dream. The reality there is not so simple.

title: Emi Okabe and Yukie Onoda / Katsurako Ibuki and Wakana Tabata
overview: Emi left Awajima before graduating. No one knows why until long after.

title: Katsurako Ibuki and Natsuko Kusanagi / Ruriko Yamaji and Natsuko Kusanagi
overview: Before she became the respected teacher she is today, before she became a bully, Katsurako was troubled.

title: Kayo Yomogida and Saori Yamagata / Wakana Tabata and Saeko Tabata / Takuto Kashiwagi and Sayaka Yoshimura
overview: Kayo and Saori used to be a team. In a way, they still are.

title: Asami Ohkubo / Midori Asaka and Leo Asagami
overview: Asami's parents are religious. That shouldn't be a problem for her, except...

title: Awajima Ghost Stories
overview: "Such good memories," says a voice in the hallway, but no one's there.

title: Saori Yamagata and Mikako Takeuchi / Mikako Takeuchi and Saori Yamagata
overview: Saori, Kayo and Mikako were hoping to perform together in the Awajima Revue Troupe, but life got in the way.

title: Sara Takanashi / Eri Fujisawa / Shizuka Utagawa
overview: It was a string of coincidences that inspired Sara to apply to Awajima.

title: Awajima Cultural Festival / Akiho Kashiwabara and Wakana Tabata
overview: Wakana participates as a guest at the Awajima Cultural Festival and shares some reflections.

title: Shinji Hasegawa and Utako Natsuki / Fumiko Shiro's Daughter / Katsurako Ibuki and Emi Okabe
overview: Shinji grew up idolizing his mother. He shares her story -- his story -- in an interview.

title: Emi Okabe and Katsurako Ibuki
overview: Wakana visits Ms. Katsurako at the hospital. She has some final wishes.

title: A Hundred Scenes of Awajima
overview: Wakana's book becomes a social phenomenon, leaving Awajima and its fans in a rough spot.
